notes.page_content: The manuscript sets out the barred-V intersection assertion for beta in I setminus K, then writes a stronger single-alpha inclusion. It gives a Lemme and a Corollaire naming the Pi_K ring partition, and closes with an assertion of immediacy by recurrence on card K >= 0.
